newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR shares hit three year low.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR shares hit three year low.

text.p: The shares of building products and sugar conglomerate CSR Ltd hit their lowest level for more than three years after the company released disappointing half year results on Monday and signalled a weaker full year result.
At 3.35 p.m. (0435 GMT), CSR stock was five cents weaker at A$4.00, its lowest level since August 1993.
On Monday, CSR said net profit in the first six months to September 30 fell 24 percent to A$154.7 million and predicted lower second half earnings and a likely fall in second half dividend.
"The result was disappointing but coming on top of this was about a 30 percent fall in earnings from Softwood Holdings," said Diane Jenner, a dealer at Sydney broker, Dicksons.
CSR owns nearly all of Softwood Holdings which it took over in 1989.
On Tuesday, Softwood said its half year net profit fell 34 percent to A$7.48 million.
